verdict.rationale: Factory's docs show clear support for autonomous task delegation (e.g., assigning a Linear/Jira issue to Factory to have Droid 'investigate, implement, and test the work,' analyzing codebases and proposing fixes, running headless via droid exec), which covers the diagnose-and-fix workflow generically rather than as a named 'bug fix' feature. Missing for 10: a dedicated bug-triage/root-cause workflow explicitly framed around reported bugs, and independent/hands-on evidence confirming successful autonomous bug fixes in practice.
